summary.text: Detrick Deburr is the Democratic nominee for the Texas House of Representatives, District 65, and a software engineer by profession.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had served on planning and zoning commissions in North Texas for almost 17 years.

paragraphs.text: Deburr was born in Monroe, Louisiana, and attended Neville High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In his 2024 survey answers he said he lives in The Colony, Texas, and had served on planning and zoning commissions for eight years in Cedar Hill and nine years in The Colony.
He also said his first job, at age 17, was a summer position at a General Motors assembly plant.
Deburr was a candidate for the same seat in 2024, when Mitch Little defeated him in the general election.

In that year's survey, he said he opposed school vouchers as presented, supported Medicaid expansion, and supported raising the legal age to buy assault weapons to at least 21 and requiring a background check on every gun sale.
